title: From Toxicity to Conformity: Adaptive user behavior to social norms in Telegram communities
reasoning: The paper is a behavioral study focusing on how human users in Telegram communities adapt their levels of toxic speech to conform to local group norms. While it discusses 'antisocial behavior' and 'social norms,' it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or specific ethical/moral frameworks in the context of language models or as a primary research component.
